decisions.action: POWO/WCVP and ITIS independently accept the species. Existing learner species name correct; no rename or duplicate card.
POWO lists the 1898 name as the single heterotypic synonym; ITIS agrees. Preserve as alias, not a separate accepted species.
POWO/WCVP and ITIS accept at species rank, 1853 original publication. Existing learner name and author correct.
The checked POWO taxon page has no Synonyms section and ITIS reports none; this is an observation of these current sources, not a universal assertion that historical names cannot exist.
POWO/WCVP accepts Swartz 1797 name at species rank; ITIS agrees. Keep author Sw. when interpreting historical records.

decisions.rank: homotypic synonym; genus not validly published
decisions.action: POWO maps to C. virgata Sw. and explicitly notes that the genus was not validly published; ITIS also maps this combination.
POWO and ITIS place this historical name under C. virgata Sw.; not a new learner species.

decisions.rank: historical variety, heterotypic synonym in POWO
decisions.action: POWO lists this variety as synonym of C. virgata Sw.; do not create an accepted variety card from this historical rank alone.

decisions.rank: illegitimate later homonym, NOT C. virgata Sw.
decisions.action: POWO expressly marks P.Durand 1808 as nom. illeg. homonym. post. and synonym of C. radiata. Never route authorless historical C. virgata records automatically to feather fingergrass.
POWO accepts C. radiata separately; it is the mapping for the P.Durand later homonym, not a synonym of accepted C. virgata Sw. No installation or county audit.

decisions.source_name: Chloris virgata var. breviseta (Benth.) Peter [POWO formatting]
decisions.action: POWO places the historical variety under separately accepted C. pilosa, and ITIS agrees on accepted species. Historical virgata epithet alone does not establish C. virgata Sw. identity.

decisions.source_name: Chloris virgata var. breviseta author citation
decisions.action: POWO prints (Benth.) Peter; ITIS prints (Benth.) Pilger ex Peter. Mapping to C. pilosa is supported, but exact authorship should be checked against the original combination before normalizing source labels.

decisions.source_name: Individual source-labelled photographs of three installed Chloris species
decisions.action: Accepted-name and synonym verification cannot confirm species-level identity of source-labelled photos. Preserve existing anatomical photo gaps, image source labels, scientific holds, and canonical cards.

decisions.source_name: Potential Chloris hybrid identity or ancestry of learner photographs
decisions.action: No hybrid ancestry inferred for any individual photograph. Previously reviewed named C. × subdolichostachya remains separately documented and outside this batch; do not reopen or alter its claim or card.

source_notes.POWO_WCVP: 2026-10-24 POWO accepted species and synonym pages checked. No county or range inference drawn.
source_notes.ITIS: 2026-10-24 ITIS current reports checked; some underlying taxonomic data sources are older and exact authorship discrepancies retained.
source_notes.cross_species_boundary: The name Chloris virgata is author-sensitive: Sw. (1797) accepted species; P.Durand (1808) later homonym mapped to separately accepted C. radiata. Historical var. breviseta mapped to C. pilosa.
source_notes.hold_boundary: Scientific taxon acceptance is not proof of an individual photo's botanical identity or hybrid parentage.
